summary: Rexel S.A., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the distribution of low voltage electrical products for the residential, commercial, and industrial markets in France, rest of Europe, North America, and the Asia-Pacific. The company offers electrical supplies and solutions including industrial control, automation and specialty products. It also offers a range of digital channels: automated logistics, webshops, mobile apps, online tools for product configuration, and electronic data interchanges. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Paris, France.
